content.text: Analyze the codebase structure and identify all API endpoints

I'll analyze the codebase to identify all API endpoints. Let me start by exploring the project structure.

Found the following API endpoints in backend/src/api/routes.ts:

1. GET /api/sessions - List sessions
2. GET /api/sessions/:sessionId - Get session details
3. GET /api/projects - List projects
4. POST /api/refresh - Refresh cache
5. GET /api/health - Health check
6. POST /api/errors - Report errors
7. GET /api/subagents/running - List running subagents
8. GET /api/subagents/history - List subagent history
9. GET /api/subagents/:id - Get subagent details
10. POST /api/subagents/search - Search subagents
11. POST /api/subagents/refresh - Refresh subagent cache

Analysis complete!
